title: Capability
description: A normalized, entity-independent feature (GRAPH.md §3). This is the extensibility hinge: constraints are expressed against capabilities rather than entity types, so a constraint written today applies correctly to categories that do not exist yet.

definition.description: Must be written so that two researchers independently decide the same way whether an entity provides it. Vague capabilities produce a graph that filters incorrectly and silently.

applies_to_slots.description: Empty means it can apply anywhere. Deliberately permissive — capabilities cross layers.

evidence_requirement.description: documented: vendor states it. demonstrated: observed working. measured: quantified. Sets the bar for a provides edge.

measurement.description: Where the capability is a matter of degree rather than presence.

substitutable_by.description: Lets the engine say 'lacks X but compensates with Y' rather than eliminating a candidate outright.

negates.description: Capabilities that cannot coexist. Used to detect contradictory constraint sets before they silently return zero results.
